What We Do

Roofing, Driveways and Landscaping

Two divisions, one team. From a slipped tile or a leaking chimney to a full re-roof, a new resin driveway or a garden made over.

New Roofs

Full strip and re-roof in new tiles, from bungalows to houses with dormers.

See more

Flat Roofs

Rubber flat roofs for extensions, garages and dormers, with rooflights and lanterns fitted.

See more

Roof Repairs and Chimneys

Slipped tiles, leaks, dry verge, ridge tiles and chimney repairs or removal, often fitted in within days.

See more

Driveways

Resin, block paving and tarmac driveways, laid on a proper base in the colour and finish you choose.

See more

Patios and Paths

Resin and slabbed patios and garden paths, shaped around the garden you already have.

See more

Garden Landscaping

Patios, paths and paved areas that finish the garden off, planned around how you use it.

See more

About Us

The Team Behind Smart Call Contractors

Smart Call Contractors is run by Alex and John from Grimsby. We do roofing, from repairs to full re-roofs, and we lay resin, block paving and tarmac driveways and patios, so one local team can look after the whole outside of your home.

We quote quickly, give a fair price and tell you exactly what needs doing before we start. If we find more once the job is opened up, you hear about it first. We turn up when we say we will, keep you updated as we go and leave the site tidy.

Alex and JohnOwners, Smart Call Contractors
